role: Independent Yggdrasil training-gaps research contributor only; Unified Causal Intelligence Amalgam Work chat owns canonical model and any integration.
purpose: One disjoint frozen source-free direct-weight-vs-conventional matched-information staged learning comparison after WSP212 qualified refit. WSP210 invalid, WSP211 unqualified, WSP212 consumed calibration never reused.
hypothesis: Contradiction-gated two-sweep native-style factor edits retain original B0 facts and improve prediction on held novel pair groups, at lower writing cost than converged conventional rank4 full-refit, and exceed equally write-budgeted surprise/random gating.

cohort.synthetic_generator: Independent SHA256 WSP213|seed|allele|pos|dim, integer factor element ((digest[0] mod 7)-3); dot /9 exactly, rank4, C and D alleles; latent vectors hidden from all fitted arms.
cohort.splits: WSP200 salted pair_group, FIT B0 B1 B2 B3 cumulative; PUBLIC_DEV site-pair groups only decoded and their labels generated ONCE after all arms finish B3; no VALID, RESERVED or original GFP labels opened.

arms.candidate: Unmodified WSP200 Learner(mode=contradiction,rank=4); B0 fixed 16 sweeps all coordinates; B1-B3 eligible contradiction-selected addresses at most 25%, with exactly two ordinary coordinate sweeps. No added algorithm hyperparameters.
arms.strong_conventional: Unmodified WSP211 BlockedFullRefit(mode=full_refit,rank4); same FIT rows, same hash init, WSP200 exact normal equations and ridge lambda0.2; 8 sweeps per objective check, at most 100 checks per stage, three check relative plateau 1e-6; requires convergence each stage as qualified WSP212.
arms.equal_write_controls: Unmodified WSP200 surprise and random selected from eligible pool, each matched EXACT candidate stage-address write count (B1-B3); two coordinate sweeps and same rows. Where candidate 0 writes, both have 0. B0 identical full 16-sweep initial fit. Positive mismatch is experiment invalid.
arms.other_controls: WSP200 always (all new addresses, two sweeps after B0) and no_update (B0 16 sweeps, no later writes), standardized zero interaction; exact hidden generator is a privileged unattainable ceiling only and cannot enter scientific comparison.
arms.info_budget: All trained arms see exactly the same staged FIT rows and evidence identities; no prior worlds trained or fed as initial state; same initial factor values; matched written addresses not guaranteed equal, matched COUNT by contract. Converged refit receives much higher compute and is only a strongest baseline (not equal-compute).

metrics: Cold checkpoint bytes reserialize exactly and same B0 predictions after each stage for every arm
B0 historical MSE at B0..B3 and B0 functional drift; writing addresses and actual solves, wall-perf-ns, source row hashes
Held PUBLIC_DEV pair-group weighted RMSE after B3; zero negative baseline; world-level winner flags
Exact candidate vs surprise/random write counts B1..B3; all arms per-stage stage monotonic, unique IDs and group isolation
Linux/Windows numeric metric parity <=1e-8 absolute OR 1e-8 relative; ignore wall times and checksum differences across operating systems
Source fences forbidding all previous or protected cohorts, valid parent, G29 pinned source, full final regression each OS

decision.INVALID: Any conventional refit stage nonconvergence, same-evidence violation, malformed/empty cohort, source violation, cold-restore corruption, repeat ID, nonfinite metric, cross-platform numerical parity failure, or incomplete CI. No scientific hypothesis conclusion.
decision.DIRECT_GAIN: At least 3/4 worlds: direct B3 B0 MSE <= 1.05 x qualified refit; direct held RMSE <= .95 x refit; direct held RMSE <= .95 x best matched-write surprise/random; direct total coordinate solves strictly less than qualified refit; no permitted science first use claimed.
decision.NO_GAIN: Primary valid but DIRECT_GAIN not met. Report all world diagnostics including negative or tie; no post-outcome retuning or seed reuse.
decision.limits: Only source-free development and held site-pair transfer; not an unfamiliar causal-law family, not native Amalgam learning, not SCIENTIFIC_PASS; strong control compute budget explicitly differs. No claim of AGI or general intelligence.
decision.next: If qualified and gain positive, independently freeze new genuinely unfamiliar relationship families and matched-compute comparisons; if negative, diagnose on fresh separately preregistered cohort. Preserve nulls.

execution.preflight: Before any WSP213 primary model fitting run inherited root, WSP200, WSP209, WSP210 smoke-only, WSP211 allowlist-only, WSP212 prereg source-only and WSP213 new static/negative preflights; G29 source exact.
execution.primary: ONE fresh WSP213 frozen primary per GitHub-hosted Linux and Windows, each produces bounded JSON receipt; independent cross-platform parity job. Never replay based on observed outcome.
execution.source_controls: No self-hosted runners, scheduler, owner process, paid API, local model or original data.

freeze: This prereg commit must precede any new 213 code and any evaluation outcome. Cohort is retired after first evaluated pass; any implementation blocker must be documented, repaired without changing frozen hypothesis, and requalified.
